Fewer than three is fine, and none if none is left. Never pick a listing that you would describe as only a part, or whose photo shows something else. For each pick write one short, plain sentence each: what it is, why it fits what they asked, and one thing to watch for, such as size, pack count, fit or delivery. Use only what the listing says. Never mention a price or the shop. Refer to listings only by their id. Then say whether any listing above their limit is the thing they asked for.
